book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: U BꞌAXA Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU CORINTO U bꞌaxa uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Corinto uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Ni taqꞌ bꞌen u Pablo itzii
Ineꞌ in Pablo, as kat molol in tiꞌ vok apóstolil tiꞌ u Jesucristo, tan aꞌeꞌ nisaꞌ u Tiixheꞌ sviꞌ. As at u qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ u Sóstenes tzitzaꞌ sunkꞌatz.

As tuk untzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u uꞌujeꞌ sete, jankꞌal ex uveꞌ nemol etibꞌ tiꞌ enachat Tiixh tu u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ Corinto, as ex uvaꞌ txaael veꞌt ex taꞌn Aak, as ekꞌuchtaj veꞌteꞌ uvaꞌ txaael veꞌt ex taꞌn Aak. As jit kuxh sete ni vaqꞌkat bꞌen u uꞌujeꞌ. Pet antu unjoltu unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ ni niman u Jesucristo, kꞌuxh katil kuxh atkat unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, tan Aakeꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ. As Aakeꞌ viBꞌaal unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ skajayil.
Aꞌ u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo la aqꞌon vibꞌaꞌnileꞌ setiꞌaj tiꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatineꞌ sevatzaj.
Ni taqꞌ u Pablo taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ
As ni vaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ setiꞌ sbꞌenameen, as tiꞌ u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ kat taqꞌ Aak setiꞌ, ex uvaꞌ at veꞌt ok ex kꞌatz u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.
As ibꞌaꞌnil kuxh Aak as nimal bꞌaꞌnil kat etillu veꞌteꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat alax veꞌt viyol Aakeꞌ sexoꞌl. As at veꞌt etxumbꞌal staꞌn,
tan kat yakꞌin veꞌt u yoleꞌ tu vetaanxelaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat kuchus sete tiꞌ u Cristoeꞌ.
As tul uvaꞌ yeꞌxnaj ul u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ unpajte, as yeꞌl umaꞌtoj bꞌaꞌnil nisaꞌvit setiꞌ, tan ayaꞌl chit ekꞌuꞌl netxꞌebꞌoneꞌ tiꞌ u tulebꞌal Aakeꞌ.

As Aakeꞌ la lochon ex tiꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl veꞌt ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak la ibꞌaneꞌ techal la ul Aak unpajte, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌl epaav la chee vatz Aak tu u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ la ul Aak tiꞌ ibꞌanax isuuchil unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil.
As kꞌujlebꞌal kꞌuꞌl chiteꞌ u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ kat molon veꞌt ex tiꞌ etok kꞌatz viKꞌaol Aakeꞌ, u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo, tan la chit itzojpisa u Tiixheꞌ kam uvaꞌ kat tal Aak.
Niyaan u Pablo tiꞌ uvaꞌ jit eela iyolon unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús svatzaj

As nunbꞌeya sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, tukꞌ vibꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesucristoeꞌ, tiꞌ uvaꞌ vatzuloj chit eyoloneꞌ sevatzaj. As yeꞌ kuxh ijatx tibꞌ evatz. Pet eela chit vetxumbꞌaleꞌ sevatzaj la ibꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ la tal etaama.
Pet tuk val sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, uvaꞌ kat ul tal kaꞌl unqꞌa tatin u Cloé sve uvaꞌ jit eela eyolon sevatzaj.

As ni vabꞌi uvaꞌ at unjolol ex ni alon uvaꞌ: «Echen oꞌ kꞌatz u Pablo,» chꞌex netal sviꞌ. As at unjoltu ex ni alon uvaꞌ: «Echen oꞌ kꞌatz u Apolo,» chꞌex netaleꞌ. As at unjoltu ex ni alon uvaꞌ: «Echen oꞌ kꞌatz u Cefas,» chꞌex netaleꞌ. As at ex ni alon uvaꞌ: «Echen oꞌ kꞌatz u Cristo,» chꞌex netaleꞌ.
¿As jatvaꞌl qꞌi elnal vitenam u Cristo stuul uvaꞌ netaleꞌ? ¿Moj in uvaꞌ kat kam in vatz u kuruseꞌ setiꞌ? As tul kat kuꞌ veꞌt ex xeꞌ aꞌ, ¿as ma tukꞌ vunbꞌiieꞌ kat kuꞌkat ex?
As ni vaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl umaꞌtoj ex kat vaqꞌ kuꞌ ex xeꞌ aꞌ. Pet taꞌn kuxh u Crispo tukꞌ u Gayo kat vaqꞌ kuꞌ xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ yeꞌl umaj ex la alon uvaꞌ kat vaqꞌ kuꞌ ex xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ tukꞌ vunbꞌiieꞌ.
As kꞌuxh taꞌn kuxh kat vaqꞌ kuꞌ unqꞌa tatin u Estéfanas xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ, as yeꞌ ni tul sunkꞌuꞌl asoj kat vaqꞌ kuꞌ umaꞌtoj uxhchil xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ.

Tan yeꞌl in chajel koj in taꞌn u Cristoeꞌ tiꞌ vaqꞌat kuꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ xeꞌ aꞌ. Pet kat ichaj in Aak tiꞌ valat u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As tul kat val isuuchil u yoleꞌ sexoꞌl, as jit unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ kat val sete uvaꞌ ni tal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ at itxumbꞌal, tan vatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ as yeꞌl itxaꞌk vikamebꞌal u Cristo vatz u kuruseꞌ.
Ni tal u Pablo uvaꞌ aꞌ u Cristo kꞌuchul tetz tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ

As yeꞌl kuxh itxaꞌk u yoleꞌ tiꞌ vikamebꞌal u Cristo vatz u kuruseꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ ech ibꞌen tu u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ. Pet ech koj oꞌ uvaꞌ niqꞌalpu oꞌ u Tiixheꞌ, tan tukꞌ viyakꞌil u yoleꞌ niqꞌalpukat oꞌ Aak.
Tan tzꞌibꞌamal kan umaꞌl u yol uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Tuk unsotzsa veꞌt vitxumbꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ nijeꞌsa tibꞌ taꞌn vitxumbꞌaleꞌ.
As la veesa iqꞌii vitxumbꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ at itxumbꞌal ni taleꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: ¿As kam kat itxꞌol unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ? ¿As kam kat itxꞌol unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ chusel tibꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tzaqꞌiteꞌ? ¿As kam kat itxꞌol unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ootzin tetz unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ni tuch vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ cheel? Tan kat teesa u Tiixheꞌ iqꞌii unqꞌa vatz txꞌavaꞌilla txumbꞌaleꞌ skajayil uveꞌ bꞌaꞌn te unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

Tan tukꞌ kuxh vitxumbꞌal u Tiixheꞌ as kat tal veꞌt Aak bꞌaxa uvaꞌ yeꞌ la itxꞌol unqꞌa tenameꞌ tootzit veꞌt Aak tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ. As kꞌuxh jit kuxh latzꞌ u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni talpu tiꞌ u Jesús te unqꞌa tenameꞌ, as bꞌaꞌn te Aak uvaꞌ la qꞌalpul veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ vatz vipaaveꞌ tiꞌ inimat u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uvaꞌ la paxsal xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ.

As aꞌ ni tal unqꞌa tiaal Israel uvaꞌ la til chajnaj umaꞌl u kꞌuchbꞌal tetz tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ. Pet ech koj unqꞌa jit tiaal Israel, tan aꞌ kuxh u vatz txꞌavaꞌilla txumbꞌaleꞌ nichuk chajnaj uvaꞌ nim talchu vatz chajnaj.

Pet u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ nu kupaxsa, as aꞌeꞌ ni taleꞌ uvaꞌ la ootzil veꞌt u Tiixheꞌ taꞌn u Cristo uvaꞌ kat kam vatz u kuruseꞌ. Ech koj unqꞌa tiaal Israel, tan la yan vitxumbꞌal chajnajeꞌ taꞌn u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ni taleꞌ. As jit kuxh yol u yoleꞌ te unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ jit tiaal Israel.

Pet ech koj oꞌ, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ molomal veꞌt oꞌ taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ, kꞌuxh oꞌ tiaal Israel as kꞌuxh jit oꞌ tiaal Israel, tan aꞌ vikamebꞌal u Cristo kꞌuchbꞌal tetz viyakꞌil u Tiixheꞌ. As kꞌuchbꞌal tetz vibꞌaꞌnil vitxumbꞌal Aakeꞌ.
As kꞌuxh yeꞌl itxaꞌk vitxumbꞌal u Tiixheꞌ vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ, as yeꞌxhkam la txakon stiꞌ uvaꞌ ni taleꞌ, as yeꞌl umaj vatz txꞌavaꞌilla txumbꞌal la lejon tiꞌ vitxumbꞌal Aakeꞌ.

As etitzꞌataj, vitzꞌin vatzik, kam uvaꞌ bꞌanik etaꞌn tul uvaꞌ kat imolo ex u Tiixheꞌ, tan kaꞌlik kuxh ex uveꞌ atik etxumbꞌal tiꞌ u vatz txꞌavaꞌilla txumbꞌaleꞌ. As kaꞌlik kuxh ex uveꞌ atik etijleꞌm xoꞌl unqꞌa emooleꞌ. As kaꞌlik kuxh ex uveꞌ nim eyolbꞌeleꞌ xoꞌl vemooleꞌ.

Pet kat itxaa ex Aak, kꞌuxh yeꞌlik etxumbꞌal vatz unqꞌa tenameꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la el iqꞌii unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ at itxumbꞌal uveꞌ ni taleꞌ. As kat itxaa ex Aak uvaꞌ yeꞌl etijleꞌm ati tiꞌ teesal iqꞌii unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ at tijleꞌm uvaꞌ ni taleꞌ.
As aꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kat itxaa Aak uvaꞌ ni tixvaleꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl iqꞌii ni toksaleꞌ tiꞌ teesal iqꞌii unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ nijeꞌsa tibꞌ,
aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌxhebꞌil la ijeꞌsa veꞌt tibꞌ vatz u Tiixheꞌ.

Tan tukꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ kat toksakat veꞌt ok oꞌ Aak kꞌatz u Jesucristo. As aꞌ u Jesucristo aqꞌol tetz kutxumbꞌal taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ. As Aak oksan qetz jikla aamail. As yeꞌl veꞌt kupaav at vatz u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ, tan chooel veꞌt u kupaaveꞌ taꞌn u Jesucristo,
aqꞌal uvaꞌ ech la kubꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uveꞌ ni tal umaꞌt u yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Abꞌil uvaꞌ la toksa jeꞌ iqꞌii tiꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ
as aꞌ la etoksakat veꞌt eqꞌii tiꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.
